title: observability: token-kv cost/latency dashboards + alert tuning enhancements
author: Aisha Kapoor
ci_checks: build: pass; unit-tests: pass; integration-tests: flaky -> rerun passed; lint: pass; e2e-smoke: pass
description: Context: customers and SRE have asked for more granular token-level observability for KV cache usage so we can surface cost/latency tradeoffs per route and per model variant. This PR adds Prometheus metrics, tracing span improvements, new Grafana dashboard panels, and alert tuning for token-level cost and latency signals. Motivation: reduce mean time to detect regressions in caching behavior and provide product teams clear per-token cost attribution for optimization work. What I changed: - Added new metrics: redwood_inference_tokens_total (labels: route, model, outcome), redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket (histogram by token_type: prompt|generated|kv_lookup), redwood_token_cost_microcents_total - Enhanced tracing: span names now include model.short and route.id, added attributes for kv.cache_hit and token_index to hot paths - Grafana: added dashboard panels for token-level cost breakdown (by route/model), KV hit-rate heatmap, per-token latency percentile panels, and a new "Cost/Latency per 1000 tokens" summary row - Alerts: tuned existing alerts to use token-rate-normalized thresholds and added alert redwood_alert_kv_hit_rate_drop for >10% drop over 5m and redwood_alert_token_latency_regression for p95 increase >2x over baseline - Backwards compatibility: metrics are additive and default to 0 when not present; dashboards include a compatibility toggle for older model label names - Tests: unit tests for metrics instrumentation, integration test that runs a synthetic workload to validate KV hit-rate panels and alert firing - Docs: updated observability docs with metric names, example PromQL and dashboard links (internal Grafana) Checklist: - [x] Metrics instrumentation added - [x] Tracing spans updated and smoke-tested - [x] Grafana panels added and validated against test cluster - [x] Alerts tuned and tested (simulated) - [x] Docs updated and release notes drafted Related: ENG-1123 (token-level observability epic), SUP-8721 (customer incident that motivated this change).
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) instrument token-level metrics + initial dashboards; 2) refine histogram buckets and add token cost metric; 3) tune alerts and fix tracing attributes. Includes small refactor to metrics registry for label cardinality protection.
review_conversation: Reviewer Liam: please limit label cardinality — suggested adding route.bucket and model.family labels; requested changes around histogram buckets. Author Aisha: addressed by normalizing model -> model.family and adding label whitelist in telemetry/labels.go. Reviewer Ravi: asked for Alertmanager escalation policy change for production alerts; suggested 2-minute vs 5-minute window. Author: kept 5m for metrics stability but added P0 escalation for sustained drops >15% over 15m. Reviewer Sofia: asked for integration test determinism; author added a deterministic synthetic workload and documented random seeds. Approvals: after fixes, Ravi and Liam approved; Sofia approved after test adjustments.
release_notes: Added token-level metrics and dashboards for KV cache and token cost/latency. New alerts for KV hit-rate drops and token-latency regressions. No breaking changes. See docs/observability/token-level-metrics.md for migration notes and example PromQL queries.
